pressOrOkToEdit: Press ▼ or OK to edit settings.

warn.language: ⚠ Work in progress: only English is fully translated.
warn.markovLlmModel: ⚠ Runs on the CPU and needs a few GB of memory. English only. The first reply is slow.
warn.asciiModeEnabled: ⚠ ASCII mode overrides the theme until turned off.

desc.ctrlNoclip: Hold CTRL to walk through walls, events and encounters.
desc.mapBattleMode: Turn Battle: classic turn-based scene. Strategic Battle: tactical fights on the map grid.
desc.battleMode: Turn Battle: classic turn-based scene. Strategic Battle: tactical fights on the map grid.
desc.mapStreaming: Joins neighbouring procedural squares into one seamless map. Off loads one square at a time.
desc.runInBackground: Keeps the game running when its window is not focused.
desc.weatherVolume: Volume of outdoor ambience: rain, storms, wind and biome sounds. Interiors are unaffected.
desc.musicArtistDisplay: Shows the current track and artist.
desc.battleMusicMode: Biome: the local battle theme. Selected Track: the track below. Random: a new track each battle. None: no music.
desc.markovLlmModel: GGUF model used for generated dialogue. Off uses Markov chains. Put .gguf files in the game's models folder.
desc.dialogueMode: How NPCs without scripted lines reply. Empathize: a Socialize action based on personality. Markovian: a generated line from the NPC's word bank.
desc.mapTooltips: Tutorial messages, quest targets and context tips on the map.
desc.dialogueVoices: Plays a short blip for each letter of dialogue, pitched to the speaker.
desc.battleLogPosition: Screen corner for the battle log.
desc.battleCommandPosition: Screen side for battle commands, skills and backpack.
desc.interactIcon: Shows a question mark over the leader when next to something hidden.
desc.lowModelDetail: Fewer polygons on procedural weapons and items. Faster on slow machines, but blockier.
desc.hyperverseInvertX: Inverts horizontal camera control on the Hyperverse title screen.
desc.starMapInvertY: Inverts vertical camera control on the star map.
desc.simulationLog: Shows a notification for every decision by party members, monsters and NPCs on the map. Busy maps get noisy.
desc.voxelVR: View the 3D world through a WebXR headset. An Enter VR button appears when a headset is connected. Applies next time you enter the 3D world.

musicArtistDisplay: First time: only the first time you hear a track. Changing this resets it.
Every time: a tape slides in whenever a track plays. Not in battle, and not twice within five minutes.
Minimal: track and artist in the usual corner notification.
shaderStyle: Off: clean models, no wobble, banding or downsampling.
SnapVertex: retro console look with wobbly vertices, colour banding and low resolution.
Pixel Art: the sprite look. Flat cel bands, chunky pixels and an optional limited palette.
battleCommandPosition: Left: commands, skills and backpack on the left.
Right: commands, skills and backpack on the right.

themeRestart: Theme saved: restart the game to apply it
resetDefaultsDone: All settings restored to their defaults
